frozen_plan.allocation_retry_policy: Recovered caching-allocator retries are retained and counted, not equivalent to failed requests; no allocator mode changes.
frozen_plan.performance_interpretation: Two fresh sessions per cell; exploratory paired estimates, not a precise CI or held-out claim.
frozen_plan.objective: mean JCT; both p95 and makespan may regress by at most 5 percent to count as constrained benefit

scope: Same-model workload-specific pool/cap test; inspect timing is diagnostic, not a formal performance comparison.
